title: PoV protocol proof manifest (scaffold)
description: Placeholder schema for the U2 proof-manifest contract. This stub is intentionally minimal and unofficial; the authoritative manifest additionally records chain epoch, both authorities, both transaction/event evidence chains, immutable deployed-code hash, source revision, reproducible build provenance, and verifier-policy version per plan KTD11. Status: scaffold — not yet implemented.

atUri.description: Placeholder property. The DID-based AT URI locating the evaluated record, e.g. at://did:plc:example/app.bsky.feed.post/abc123. Not yet enforced by this scaffold stub.

observedCid.description: Placeholder property. The observed content-addressed CID binding the exact record version attested, distinct from the mutable atUri. Not yet enforced by this scaffold stub.

harbingerTxId.description: Placeholder property. The Harbinger transaction ID recording the fact attestation or referenced evaluation. Not yet enforced by this scaffold stub.
